statement.title: Who we are
statement.text: Vreva is a digital agency for modern websites, applications and AI solutions. Behind us are more than ten years of international software development experience.
statement.more: We don't use WordPress or ready-made templates. We build every site like software, so it's unique, fast, Google-optimised and works on every device.
